# product length measured in the Nine Mile RSA 493 assembly GCA_000007765.2 (chromosome
# AE016828.3) by in silico PCR with these primers, outer primer edge to outer primer edge. Every
# locus gives exactly one product there, at hash word size 11, without the rescue pass and without
# a primer mismatch, and all seventeen lie on the chromosome; the plasmid pQpH1 carries none.
# The source heading describes panel 1 as minisatellites with a unit above 9 bp; ms26 and ms36
# are exactly 9 bp, and the remaining eight panel 1 units are 11 bp or longer.
# Fourteen of the seventeen measured products have exactly the size the identifier states. Three
# do not, and for those three ref_size above is the measured size, not the published one:
#   ms30  identifier 215 bp, measured 306 bp (+91)
#   ms31  identifier 182 bp, measured 285 bp (+103)
#   ms36  identifier 447 bp, measured 477 bp (+30)
# The locus is not in doubt in any of the three: each product starts at the gene the identifier
# names, and a search of both replicons allowing up to five mismatches per primer finds only this
# one product per pair, so no second priming site explains the published size. For ms36 the
# measured 477 bp falls inside the published estimated size range of 474-601 bp while the
# identifier's 447 bp falls below it, so 447 is most likely a transposed 477. For ms30 and ms31
# the identifier size equals the top of the published estimated size range, 215 and 182 bp, which
# suggests it was taken from the capillary estimate rather than from the sequence.
# IMPORTANT, ms30 and ms31: the published and the measured size are not a whole number of repeat
# units apart (91 bp is 5 units of 18 plus 1, and 103 bp is 14 units of 7 plus 5), so no choice of
# ref_size and ref_repeats puts this scheme's alleles on the grid the published sizes imply. A
# product of a size taken from the publication's own range is therefore called a fractional number
# of repeats at these two loci and reported as INTERMEDIATE. Confirm the two primer pairs against
# the publication before comparing ms30 or ms31 with published allele numbers. The other fifteen
# loci are unaffected.
# patterns is filled only for ms31, the one locus where the repeat unit found by repeat detection
# in the reference amplicon occurs there exactly the published number of times, so the tandem
# array cross-check is active on ms31 and skipped on the other sixteen. The source table gives no
# repeat motifs, and for the remaining loci the published copy number is not a count of whole
